cues: In the I U P A C system, the smaller group together with the oxygen is named as an alkoxy substituent, and the larger group is the parent chain.
So C H three O C H two C H three: methoxy, plus ethane, gives methoxyethane.
The common name just lists the two groups and adds the word ether: ethyl methyl ether.
